title: HMDA vs DTCP Plots
excerpt: Understand the key differences between HMDA and DTCP approvals.
content:
When buying open plots around Hyderabad, you will often hear about HMDA and DTCP approvals. Understanding the difference is crucial for a safe investment.

HMDA (Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority) is responsible for the urban planning of the Hyderabad metropolitan area. DTCP (Directorate of Town and Country Planning) handles the planning for the rest of the state.

Both approvals ensure that the layout is legally sound, has proper road widths, and designated spaces for public utilities. Choosing between them often depends on your investment horizon and budget.
